details:
=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Context section, paragraph 3 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the 2026-03-22 source under `research/squad-workflow-improvements-20260322T042436Z.md` "remains untouched," but that path does not exist in the repository.
  WHY: Readers will look for a cited source file that is absent, so the reference is stale and misleading.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Line 52-53 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [moonshotai_kimi-k2_5]
  PROBLEM: The plan says the 2026-03-22 source under `research/squad-workflow-improvements-20260322T042436Z.md` "remains untouched," but that path does not exist in the repository.
  WHY: Readers will look for a cited source file that is absent, so the reference is stale and misleading.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Approach section, dependency chain ASCII art (between lines ~90-110) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The dependency-chain diagram serializes `P5b` before `N2` even though the plan says `P5b` is standalone and can run in parallel.
  WHY: The visual ordering can unnecessarily block two independent workstreams.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 4 section 4.1 ("Schema extension"), paragraph referencing "line 35-42 currently" | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, qwen_qwen3_6-plus, x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The plan points implementers at stale line numbers such as `line 35-42 currently` for the `category` enum edit.
  WHY: Those line references are brittle and can send implementers to the wrong place in the schema file.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 3 section 3.4 ("Lint enforcement"), grep command | severity=low | confidence=2
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro]
  PROBLEM: The anti-regression grep pattern can false-positive on helper scripts that legitimately write `config.toml`.
  WHY: The check may flag the helper itself instead of only catching new inline config writes.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 2.1 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `mcp__github__get_file_contents` is not a defined tool or helper in this repository.
  WHY: A drift-detection step that calls an undefined tool would not execute as planned.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 5.1 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: `validate_fix_harness` allows `scripts/**`, which is broader than the harness-generation scope.
  WHY: That allowlist could let the self-heal path touch core scripts instead of staying confined to validation harness files.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 3.4 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The grep check `grep -rn "cat > .*config.toml << " .github/workflows/ scripts/*.sh` misses non-byte-identical variants such as `cat >config.toml<<EOF` or `tee config.toml <<EOF`.
  WHY: A too-specific pattern can let regressions slip past the lint gate.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:§5.1 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan references `.github/ai/write_guards.v1.json` without clearly saying that this PR does not create it.
  WHY: Readers may assume the file already exists in-repo instead of being a later implementation artifact.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:lines 148-150 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The claim that `update_workflows.yml` copies every `ai-*.yml` template by glob is not explicitly verified against the actual workflow/template set.
  WHY: If the glob is different, the plan would misstate which templates are propagated.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:lines 134-138 (§1.2) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The `repository_dispatch` wording in §1.2 is ambiguous about whether the central workflow or the wrapper should own that trigger.
  WHY: Implementers could add a redundant `repository_dispatch` trigger to the centralized workflow.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:§3.2 | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The proposed `codex_helpers.sh` helper overlaps with the existing `scripts/write_codex_config.sh` logic without explaining how the two relate.
  WHY: Without that clarification, the extraction can duplicate the very config-writing logic it is supposed to consolidate.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:§3.1 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: The plan assumes the Codex config block is duplicated across workflows but does not verify that the extracted helper's parameters cover any workflow-specific differences.
  WHY: If the blocks are not actually interchangeable, the helper will need more than a straight extraction.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:§5.3 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `write_guard_check` must run after the editor has produced/staged changes and before the commit step, but the plan leaves that sequencing easy to misplace.
  WHY: If the guard runs in the wrong spot, the commit path can still ship disallowed writes.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:Phase 3 section 3.4 ("Lint enforcement"), grep command | severity=medium | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_1-fast]
  PROBLEM: The grep check can miss non-byte-identical config-writing variants and therefore under-detect regressions.
  WHY: A pattern that only matches one spellings of `cat > ... config.toml` does not reliably protect the extraction.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:675 | severity=medium | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The acceptance test says to verify all 21 `ai:*` labels, but the current contract has 34 `ai:*` labels.
  WHY: Implementing the test as written would let 13 labels remain unsynced while still passing.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:6 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The Summary says "four committed feature PRs plus one evaluate-and-implement N4 PR," which contradicts the plan's own N4 implementation sections.
  WHY: The summary understates the scope of Phase 5 and can mislead reviewers about the number of implementation PRs.
- docs/plans/complete-squad-improvements-plan.md:589-591 | severity=medium | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The claim that "No information loss" occurred is too broad because several sections of the deleted report are not preserved verbatim in the plan.
  WHY: Readers may assume the plan fully replaces the deleted report when it actually omits some contextual sections and tables.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
